clue.text: Debtor is behind with money order

parts.note: DR is the bookkeeping abbreviation for debtor
aft means at the back, behind, in nautical use

explanation.surface: A debtor lags behind with a payment instruction.
explanation.definitionFit: A bank draft is a written instruction to pay a sum of money, a kind of payment order.

clue.text: Postponement to put wine production into reverse ?

parts.note: the prefix de- reverses a process, as in defrost
wine is made by fermentation, ferment

explanation.surface: A delay caused by trying to undo the making of wine.
explanation.definitionFit: Deferment is the act of putting something off, a postponement.

clue.text: In the vicinity of a boxing match

parts.note: a bout is a contest in the ring

explanation.surface: Somewhere near a prizefight.
explanation.definitionFit: About can mean near or around a place.

clue.text: Leading dentist — definitely "U"

parts.note: top means foremost, leading
a dentist draws teeth, so is a drawer

explanation.surface: The foremost tooth-puller is unmistakably upper-class.
explanation.walkthrough: U is the 1950s label for upper-class usage, as against non-U.
explanation.definitionFit: Top-drawer means of the highest social class, which U denoted.

clue.text: Poet king comes with another dirge

parts.note: Old King Cole is the merry monarch of the nursery rhyme

indicators.note: another form of the word dirge is wanted, so its letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A royal arrives bringing yet another mournful song for a poet.
explanation.walkthrough: 'another' turns DIRGE into RIDGE, which follows COLE.
explanation.definitionFit: Samuel Taylor Coleridge was the English Romantic poet of The Rime of the Ancient Mariner.

clue.text: Pressed Into folds, or into service

definitions.meaning: ... hair or pastry is pinched into ridges
to crimp was to force men into the navy, with pressed carried over

explanation.surface: Squeezed into pleats, or else conscripted.
explanation.definitionFit: Crimped means pinched into ridges, and a crimp was an agent who press-ganged sailors.

clue.text: Characters of landlords

definitions.meaning: ... of the alphabet are written characters
people who let property

explanation.surface: Personalities among property owners.
explanation.definitionFit: Letters are alphabet symbols, and letters are also those who rent out property.

clue.text: Arm for war if leader gives the word

indicators.note: the run of letters across war if leader yields the word wanted

explanation.surface: A weapon for battle, if only the commander gives the order.
explanation.walkthrough: The run sits across 'war if leader'; 'gives the word' pretends to be an order to fire.
explanation.definitionFit: A rifle is a firearm, and arms are weapons.

clue.text: Clever chap leads Eastern combine in bargaining

parts.note: a clever Dick is a know-all
a combine or ring is a group of traders fixing prices

explanation.surface: A smart fellow heads an Asian business cartel during negotiations.
explanation.definitionFit: Dickering means haggling over a price.

clue.text: Praise former type of Labour leaders

parts.note: ex means former

indicators.note: the leading letters of the words type, of and Labour are taken

explanation.surface: Commend a past kind of Labour Party chief.
explanation.definitionFit: To extol is to laud or glorify.

clue.text: Legend's Impression " on the sands of time " ?

definitions.text: Legend's Impression " on the sands of time " ?

parts.words: Legend's Impression " on the sands of time " ?
parts.note: Longfellow's Psalm of Life says great lives leave marks on the sands of time, so a legend's impression is the mark a walker's foot leaves

explanation.surface: A famous figure's lasting mark on history, as the poet put it.
explanation.definitionFit: Longfellow wrote that great men leave behind them marks of their feet on the sands of time.

clue.text: Aspect of note, in fact

indicators.note: one piece sits within the other, signalled by in

parts.note: taken as the word fact itself
E is one of the musical notes A to G

explanation.surface: A feature that is, in truth, worth noting.
explanation.definitionFit: A facet is one side or feature of something, a synonym for an aspect.

clue.text: The arm the motorist needs is a revolver

definitions.meaning: the ... arm turns inside a car's distributor
something that revolves, a spinning part

explanation.surface: The weapon a driver must carry is a handgun.
explanation.definitionFit: A car's distributor has a rotor arm, and any rotor is a part that spins round.

clue.text: Bit by bit make up a whole dinner

parts.note: to piece is to join parts together into one whole
a dinner is a meal

explanation.surface: Gradually assembling a complete dinner course by course.
explanation.definitionFit: Piecemeal means done gradually, in stages rather than all at once.

clue.text: Untidy den due to be furnished

indicators.note: an untidy den has its letters in disarray, so they are rearranged

parts.note: money that is due is owed

explanation.surface: A messy study is about to be fitted out with furniture.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Untidy' turns DEN into END, followed by OWED.
explanation.definitionFit: To be endowed with something is to be provided or equipped with it.

clue.text: Highland title, that's plain

parts.note: downs are rolling uplands, high land
a title is a right, a legal claim

explanation.surface: A Scottish aristocratic rank that is obvious.
explanation.definitionFit: Downright means utter, unmistakable, frank.

clue.text: Difficulties between us and France ?

definitions.meaning: as in dire ..., a troubled position
the Strait of Dover separates England from France

explanation.surface: Diplomatic troubles between Britain and France.
explanation.definitionFit: Straits are hardships, and the narrow sea channel between England and France is the Straits of Dover.

clue.text: Put in new order for rare sort of cooker

indicators.note: a sort of rare means the letters put in another order

parts.note: a range is a kitchen stove

explanation.surface: Reorganise for an unusual kind of stove.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sort of' turns RARE into REAR, followed by RANGE.
explanation.definitionFit: To rearrange is to reorder.

clue.text: Withdrew from contest, having scored

definitions.meaning: a horse ... from a race is withdrawn
marked with lines, as by a claw

explanation.surface: Pulled out of the competition after putting points on the board.
explanation.definitionFit: Scratched means pulled out of a race, and also marked with a sharp edge.

clue.text: It's near to the Old Bailey, son

parts.note: taken as written
in an old castle the bailey was the ward, the courtyard inside the outer wall
S is the genealogical abbreviation for son

explanation.surface: A building close to London's central criminal court, with a son.
explanation.walkthrough: The Old Bailey is London's main criminal court, but here bailey has its old castle sense of a ward or enclosure.
explanation.definitionFit: Towards can mean near in time or place, as in towards evening.

clue.text: Up-to-date type of cricket ball

definitions.meaning: a lively fashionable person of the Swinging Sixties
a ball that curves in the air

explanation.surface: A modern style of cricket ball.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket, a bowler's swinger curves sideways through the air.
explanation.definitionFit: A swinger is a trendy person, and a swinging delivery in cricket.

clue.text: Blunder by Town Crier?

definitions.meaning: a slang term for a gaffe
a town crier rings a bell, making a loud metallic din

explanation.surface: A mistake made by the official who calls out the news.
explanation.definitionFit: A clanger is British slang for a gaffe, and a bell-ringing crier is one who clangs.

clue.text: Share out cup Vera concocted

indicators.note: something concocted is mixed up, so the letters are recombined

explanation.surface: Vera made up a drink and divided it.
explanation.definitionFit: To carve up is to divide something into shares.

clue.text: -To get rid of mole is a less .-complete solution

parts.note: to scrap something is to discard it
a mole is a stone breakwater or pier

explanation.surface: Getting rid of a burrowing pest is only a partial fix.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mole' looks like the garden animal, but it is a harbour breakwater.
explanation.definitionFit: Scrappy means fragmentary, so scrappier means more patchy, less whole.

clue.text: Men succeeded in upholding this law

definitions.text: Men succeeded in upholding this law

parts.words: Men succeeded in upholding this law
parts.note: the Frankish code barred women from inheriting the throne, so only males came to the crown

explanation.surface: Only males took the throne under this rule.
explanation.definitionFit: Salic law was the Frankish code excluding women from royal succession.

clue.text: Sports ground has a slope

definitions.meaning: a playing field, as in a football field
the steepness of a roof

explanation.surface: The playing field is on an incline.
explanation.definitionFit: A pitch is a playing field, and also the angle of a roof.

clue.text: Make fun of cook

definitions.meaning: to ... someone is to mock them
to cook meat in an oven

explanation.definitionFit: Roast means both to ridicule someone and to cook in an oven.

clue.text: Maturing drink in silver container

indicators.note: one piece sits within another, signalled by in

parts.note: Ag is the chemical symbol for silver
gin is a spirit

explanation.surface: Liquor ripening in a silver vessel.
explanation.walkthrough: 'container' simply describes the silver holding the drink.
explanation.definitionFit: Ageing, here spelt with one E, means growing older or maturing.

clue.text: Run away from this sort of drama

definitions.meaning: slang for to flee
legitimate theatre, serious stage drama

explanation.surface: Flee from a play of this kind.
explanation.definitionFit: Leg it is slang for flee, and legit is short for legitimate drama, the serious stage.

clue.text: .Meantime the base is in London

parts.note: the world's mean time and its zero line of longitude are fixed at a London borough

explanation.surface: Meanwhile, headquarters is located in the capital.
explanation.walkthrough: Meantime splits into Mean Time: GMT and the prime meridian are both based at this London borough.
explanation.definitionFit: Greenwich in London is home of Greenwich Mean Time and the prime meridian.

clue.text: -Snag to curtail intermediate — sowing

parts.note: a snag is a catch, a hidden drawback
to crop is to cut short

explanation.surface: A problem in cutting back the planting between harvests.
explanation.definitionFit: A catch crop is grown between two main crops, a quick sowing in the gap.

clue.text: Spurred 'horse into river on way back

indicators.note: one piece goes into the other, signalled by into
a journey back runs the river's name in the opposite direction

parts.note: the Dee is a river in Wales and England, and another in Scotland
GG is gee-gee, a child's word for a horse

explanation.surface: A rider urged a horse into the river on the way home.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on way back' turns DEE into EED; 'into' puts GG inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Egged on means urged or spurred on.
